source_field: symbol in data/normalized/lipi_observed_faces.jsonl (Lipi export, commit fc8813a)
scope: Seal faces (type beginning SEAL). Tablets, tags, sealings, pottery and the cult field are not covered; for them the 12 October inventory rule stands unverified.

value_statuses.asserted-absent: The face carries no animal, scene or other device; checked against photographs for this label and seal type.
value_statuses.missing-unknown: The label does not tell whether the face has a motif: the motif may be absent, unrecorded, or not observable because the face is broken or worn.

rules.reason: 8 of 8 sampled rectangular faces carry one row of signs and nothing else (stratum C).
6 of 12 sampled square faces are broken or worn where a motif would be; of the 6 readable faces, 5 carry signs only and 1 shows a device (stratum A).
Not sampled; 31 objects. Kept unknown until checked, because the square-seal stratum shows that None does not always mean no motif.
9 of 12 sampled faces with - are fragments or worn (strata B and D); one square seal with - shows a large animal (M-1005), so - also covers unrecorded motifs.
Both sampled faces are dark or broken (stratum E).
4 of 4 control crops with a named motif show one (stratum K); the names themselves were not checked.
